decision.title: Globals computed on first read, the hoist guard, typed modes (packet 4.21)
decision.summary: Globals with an initializer are computed on first read through a new IR kind GLOBAL_READ, the hoist pass leaves indexed FILTERs alone, and typed modes match element name tests as schema-element().

body.p: , after , , , , , , , , , . Replaces 's and 's computation of declared variables before the body ("computation order", the evaluator's global part) and 's design of lazy globals, as built here. Verified as asks: the debug preset, every unit test, clang-tidy on the files changed, tools/check-call-cycles.py, and the whole XT40 and QT4 XQ40 suites with the release driver, compared case by case.

item.p: The hoist guard (src/ir_loop_passes.c): the guard of ("the input is not empty") is right only for loops that run their body for the first item of every non-empty input. A FILTER with a filter index tests its predicate on the index's candidates only, which may be none, so a hoisted LET raised an error the predicate never ran. The hoist pass leaves indexed FILTERs (and indexed where clauses) alone; (no pass moves STREAM bindings) is unchanged. merge-001a was not the hoist pass: fn:current-merge-group(()) was map:get(sources, ()), XPTY0004. 15.5.1: an empty $source is the whole group, an unknown name XTDE3490; the merge binds Q{XSLT}current-merge-sources to a function item that a call with an argument calls (xslt_lower_group.c, xpath_lower.c). merge-016 passed already.

GLOBAL_READ (glossary ; src/ir_internal.h): a new IR kind, the global, then the body. The global-read pass (src/ir_global_read.c, the last standard pass, after hoist so the loop passes see globals as atoms) puts one GLOBAL_READ per global with an initializer at the head of each LET chain whose expressions read it as an atom (an expression no LET holds, with the bound expressions and bodies of the LETs below it, which all run once it starts). One mechanism for XQuery and XSLT: lowering is unchanged.

The machine (src/evaluator.c, src/evaluator_global.c): a GLOBAL_READ of a BOUND global (or one without initializer) is replaced by its body (tail), and a pushed operand passes such reads at once, so a computed global costs no step () and leaves stay in place (); a FILTER predicate behind a GLOBAL_READ is not inline. An ABSENT global with an initializer gets the global part's task: it calls the initializer (BEING_COMPUTED meanwhile) and binds the value. A read while BEING_COMPUTED is XTDE0640 in a unit whose parts evaluate templates (XSLT, 9.11), XQDY0054 otherwise. While the initializer runs the current mode and template rule are absent (6.7, 9.5: mode="#current" in a global is the unnamed mode). Its task has the new flag stops_catching: a try/catch of the same unit around the read does not catch the initializer's error (XSLT 4.0, 2.4.2 and 8.3; QT4 try-006), one inside the initializer does, and the unit evaluation's asker does (fn:load-xquery-module, fn:transform). A failed initializer leaves its global ABSENT. sxml_evaluator_evaluate binds only the context global now (sxml_evaluator_bind_context_global).

XSLT (9.5): XTDE0050 for a required stylesheet parameter without a value is raised even when the parameter is never read: the main function reads each required parameter first (xslt_lower_control.c). Globals in temporary output state, xsl:message in a global and other effects now happen when the global is first read.

Typed modes (6.9.4; xslt_pattern.c, xslt_lower_template.c): a template rule applicable to a mode with typed="strict" or "lax" gets a match function of its own in which an EQName test on an axis of principal node kind element, in the first step of each relative path of the pattern, is schema-element(E): with lax when a global element declaration of E is in scope, with strict always, XTSE3105 when it is not. Priorities are those of the pattern as written.

Numbers: XT40 11,918 (HEAD with the hoist fix) to 11,943 passed, 0 errors: lazy globals 10 (accept-042, -043a, document-4061..-4065, copy-2203, square-array-201, error-0640e-2), XTDE0640 3 (error-0640d, -0640f, accumulator-031, from wrong errors), typed modes 4 (error-3105a, match-220, -221, -244), and 8 streamed cases (sx-union-012/-017/-022/-035, sf-distinct-ordered-nodes-012/-017/-022/ -035) whose expected order between a global's nodes and a streamed document's nodes is the order the trees are now made in (implementation-dependent, XDM 4.0, 2.4: nodes of different trees); the hoist fix and merge before it, 11,913 to 11,918 (merge-001a, -045, -046b, -048, error-3490a). One wrong error is now a failure: document-4066 (the eager global hid that fn:document's schema-validation option does not raise FODC0002). QT4 XQ40 whole: 45,914 passed, 0 outcomes differ at each step.

Left: document-4066 (fn:document options, PR2419); the other XT40 leftovers of (XTDE3490 of merge-097's collection URI, xml-version-007, namespace-2606/-6202, docbook-004, fn:transform's three cases, xsl:copy of JNodes, XTDE0430/0440).
